==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Julia:''' Lucio's been heading out to distant fields every day lately... They say the grass around here isn't good for the cattle anymore.
:'''Julia:''' It's almost Pela's birthday again. I should buy her some interesting storybooks this year too...
:'''Julia:''' "Beyond Solaris," "Septimont Holiday," "The Legend of Violinist 2000," "Theatre Paradiso"... Pela has read all these classics.
:'''Julia:''' Oh, sorry, I was lost in thought... My friend, which storybook on the table do you think would be suitable for my daughter?
:{{DIcon}} The Montelli.
::'''Julia:''' The Montelli... a story centered on the upper echelons of the Montelli family, steeped in themes of crime, conspiracy, assassination, and betrayal. It's just too dark.
:{{DIcon}} John Wicktorio.
::'''Julia:''' John Wicktorio... Some bad people destroyed the loyal Echo of a retired Montelli family accountant, who then revenges by exposing the old nobility's shady dealings... I don't like it.
:{{DIcon}} Pirates of Ragunna.
::'''Julia:''' Pirates of Ragunna... Recounts the adventures of a legendary captain with a morally ambiguous nature. The treasure he seeks and the spoils he plunders are, in truth, the smiles of the people. This story has been banned by The Order.
:{{DIcon}} The Card Rider Guga.
::'''Julia:''' The Card Rider Guga... It tells of a nameless hero who became a knight to stop the suffering of people, battling creatures known as Threnodian... This story is just too far-fetched.
:{{DIcon}} The Holy Echo War.
::'''Julia:''' The Holy Echo War... It tells the story of seven Echo controllers who, driven by their own desires, entered a brutal survival contest in the distant past. It's a tale of ruthless battles and deadly pursuits... This is way too cruel.
:{{DIcon}} None of these fit.
::'''Julia:''' That's true... I guess Pela has outgrown these kinds of stories. I should think it over myself.
{{Dialogue End}}
